Complete meaningful routine infrastructure work with clear direction and support from senior technical staff.  Join a collaborative team that values accountability, curiosity, clear communication, and continuous learning.  About the Role    As an IT Technical Specialist Level 2, you will own and resolve Level 2 service requests in a fast-paced MSP environment. You will investigate issues thoroughly, use available documentation and ticket history, communicate professionally with clients and colleagues, and keep work moving without needing step-by-step supervision. Larger or more complex projects will be directed and reviewed by senior team members; this position is not expected to independently architect complex solutions or act as the primary technical contact for assigned client accounts. Support and guide Level 1 technicians on escalated requests. Complete routine infrastructure work with direction, including server and Hyper-V migrations, domain controller replacements, Cisco Firepower firewall work, managed-switch replacements, VLANs, and Microsoft 365 administration. Maintain accurate documentation and communicate professionally with clients and internal teams. Qualifications    3–5 years of technical support, systems administration, or IT client-services experience. MSP experience is required. Strong troubleshooting mindset, ownership, organization, and willingness to learn unfamiliar technologies. Able to accept feedback and work collaboratively. Valid driver’s licence and reliable vehicle for onsite client visits. Available for an on-call rotation. Experience with RMM/PSA tools, preferably N-able N-central and ConnectWise Manage. Microsoft 365 and Exchange administration.  VMware and Hyper-V virtualization, including virtual machine management and routine host replacement or migration work.  Enterprise workstation deployment, configuration, and troubleshooting.  Networking fundamentals, including switches, routers, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, and VPN connectivity.
